It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 18, 2021}} The district encompasses the northernmost portion of the province and consists of the city of [[Dapitan]] and adjacent municipalities of [[La Libertad, Zamboanga del Norte|La Libertad]], [[Mutia, Zamboanga del Norte|Mutia]], [[Piñan]], [[Polanco, Zamboanga del Norte|Polanco]], [[Rizal, Zamboanga del Norte|Rizal]], [[Sergio Osmeña, Zamboanga del Norte|Sergio Osmeña]] and [[Sibutad]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 18, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Pinpin Uy|Roberto "Pinpin" Uy Jr.]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite news|url=https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/11/13/news/roberto-uy-takes-oath-as-zambo-del-norte-representative/1919604|title=Roberto Uy takes oath as Zambo del Norte representative|first=Reina|last=Tolentino|date=November 13, 2023|accessdate=November 14, 2023|work=The Manila Times}}{{cite news|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1773357/fwd-lakas-cmd-bolsters-membership-anew-as-19-politicians-join-party|title=Lakas-CMD gets boost with 19 new members|first=Gabriel Pabico|last=Lalu|date=May 23, 2023|accessdate=November 14, 2023|website=INQUIRER.net}} ==Representation history== {| class="wikitable" ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" |# ! colspan="2" |Member ! colspan="2" |Term of office ! rowspan="2" |Congress ! rowspan="2" |Party ! rowspan="2" |Electoral history ! rowspan="2" width="33%" |Constituent [[Local government in the Philippines|LGUs]] |- |- !Image !Name
